title: IRIS ARC Next Runtime
description: Private independently versioned IRIS-X offline runtime, source commit 94135a858fb650bb0bc7c299ea582184983509ad. All model weights/configs/tokenizers remain unchanged. Original v1 validator still rejects the defective index. Local production repair and full HF/GPU loading are not attested by this code artifact.
